name: P-H3-Image
description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing with the fixed 8-step schedule. Use the P-H3 single-frame VAE and either Qwen3-VL-4B with the P-H3 text connector or the MiniMax-H3 Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder. Reference images need the matching vision tower.

slots.label: MiniMax-H3 Qwen 3 VL 32B or P-H3 Qwen 3 VL 4B Text Encoder
Vision projector (required when not included in the text encoder)
P-H3 Text Connector (for Qwen 3 VL 4B, when not included in the text encoder)
